source.title: TESU Approved Provider Directory: current approved and provisionally approved providers
source.scope: Provider approval status only. Study.com is approved; Sophia, StraighterLine, Saylor Academy and CLEP remain provisionally approved — review pending. No course equivalency or individual credit award is created.

scope: Provider review status only, independent of receiving-course equivalencies, exact degree placement, source recommendation periods and an individual student credit award. Provider review status establishes neither student enrollment permission nor a prohibition.
findings: The live directory still lists Study.com in its Approved section.
The live directory still lists Sophia, StraighterLine, Saylor Academy and CLEP in its Provisionally Approved – Review Pending section.
Provider approval alone does not resolve the receiving-course and program-placement evidence missing from existing Study.com candidates.
Do not remove a provisional restriction because ACE publishes a university-submitted receiving match, or because a provider markets a TESU pathway.

TESU expressly separates provider approval from course-equivalency evaluation. Neither the Approved nor Provisionally Approved directory heading establishes student permission to enroll or a prohibition.

candidateBaselineAssessment.method: Existing selected/candidate outside options are retained; this policy recheck creates no new receiving awards and no publication-ready baselines.

policySource.title: TESU Educational Provider Review: provider approval and course evaluation are distinct
policySource.scope: Provider approval is followed by separate course-equivalency evaluation and does not guarantee acceptance of every course. The policy does not establish student enrollment permission or a ban for provisional providers.
